image_description: A black and white photograph showing a bicycle disc brake rotor mounted on a wheel hub. The rotor has a distinctive wavy/flower-petal edge design with multiple cutouts. The wheel spokes radiate outward. In the background, there's a bicycle frame with a 'ROCK SHOX' sticker, and some shoes are visible on the floor. The image has a date stamp '08.12.2010' and a signature in the bottom right corner.
